Hardening for Child Lock. While the touch lock is on it swallows the back and volume buttons, blocks swipes, closes the notifications panel if it is dragged down, and returns to the app you handed over if the child leaves it. It also recognises the volume-button pattern that switches the lock on and off, and can lock automatically when a call connects or a video goes full screen in apps you choose. It never reads or stores what is on screen.
Volume-button lock toggle and hardening for Child Lock

Nothing leaves your phone. Child Lock has no internet permission, collects no data and never reads what is on screen.

Child Lock uses Android’s accessibility service to work as a parental touch lock, not as an accessibility aid.

While the lock is on it will:
• Notice volume-button presses, for the lock/unlock pattern
• Block the back and volume buttons and home/back swipes
• Close the notifications panel if it is dragged down
• Bring back the app you handed over if the child leaves it

While the lock is off it only watches which app is in front, and whether a call or video is playing, for auto-lock.

It never reads, stores or sends anything shown on screen. No data leaves your phone.

Press volume %1$s again. A message confirms “Child Lock off”.
Hold one finger in each chosen corner for the hold duration. A ring fills around the badge; a buzz confirms the unlock.
Hold the badge for the hold duration until the keypad appears, then enter your PIN.
Hold volume up and volume down together for the hold duration. The corner hold also works.

The lock is never saved. If anything goes wrong, restart the phone and it starts unlocked. The power button always works. The Quick Settings tile can lock but never unlock, so dragging down from the top does not help a child.

Lock by itself at the right moment: when a video call connects in WhatsApp (not a voice call, unless you choose that), when YouTube, iPlayer or Netflix goes full screen, or simply when a game opens. A countdown gives you time to get things ready; switching away or pressing the volume pattern cancels it.
Tick an app, then choose the moment that locks it. Changes save as you go.
Any call connects, video or voice
Anything plays, full screen or not
